input.story: As a shopper, I want my Aurora Storefront account to lock quickly after too many wrong passwords so that my account stays safe.
input.context: Aurora Storefront sign-in. The counter is per account.

criteria.text: The account locks after 5 failed sign-in attempts
A locked account stays locked for 30 minutes

test_cases.title: The account locks on the fifth wrong password
steps: Open the Aurora Storefront sign-in page
Enter the right email and a wrong password five times
test_cases.expected: The page shows: Account locked for 30 minutes

test_cases.title: A fourth wrong password does not lock the account
steps: Open the Aurora Storefront sign-in page
Enter the right email and a wrong password four times
Enter the right password
test_cases.expected: The shopper is signed in and no lock message is shown

test_cases.title: A locked account is still locked after 29 minutes
steps: Lock the account with five wrong passwords
Wait 29 minutes
Enter the right password
test_cases.expected: The page shows: Account locked for 30 minutes

test_cases.title: A locked account opens again after 30 minutes
steps: Lock the account with five wrong passwords
Wait 30 minutes
Enter the right password

test_cases.title: An unknown email is refused without saying it is unknown
steps: Enter an email no account uses
Enter any password
test_cases.expected: The page shows: That email or password is wrong

problems.says: The limit applies per account, even from different IPs and devices: Counting per network address stops nobody. Anyone can use a second phone or network.
TC-04: expected result has no checkable outcome
problems.fix: Rewrite it so the expected result can only be true or false, and say the exact values it uses.

problems.says: The form submits with the Enter key: Most people press Enter to sign in and never touch the button.

add_tests.title: Sign in with the email typed in capital letters
steps: Open the sign-in page
Enter USER@EXAMPLE.COM and the correct password
Submit
add_tests.expected: The user is signed in to the same account as user@example.com; no new account or error is created.

add_tests.title: Unknown email and wrong password give the same message
steps: Sign in as nobody@example.com with any password and note the message
Sign in as user@example.com with a wrong password and note the message
Compare the two messages and the two response times
add_tests.expected: Both attempts show the identical message, for example 'Email or password is incorrect', and neither says which part was wrong.

add_tests.title: Script-like text in the email field is escaped, not executed
steps: Enter <script>alert(1)</script> in the email field
Enter any password and submit
Read the error message and view the page source
add_tests.expected: Sign-in fails with the normal error; the text appears escaped as plain characters, no dialog opens and no server error page is shown.

add_tests.title: The account locks on the stated attempt and not before it
steps: Fail one time fewer than the limit, then sign in with the correct password
Fail exactly the limit number of times and read the message
Fail once more and read the message again
add_tests.expected: The correct password still works one below the limit; the account locks exactly at the stated attempt, and the attempt after the limit is refused with the same lock message rather than a new error.
add_tests.test_data: limit from the criteria; try limit minus 1, limit, limit plus 1 wrong passwords

add_tests.title: Failed attempts stop counting once the window has passed
steps: Fail one time fewer than the limit
Wait until just past the stated window
Fail the same number of times again and then sign in with the correct password
add_tests.expected: The account does not lock, because the first group of attempts fell out of the window; the correct password signs the user in.
add_tests.test_data: window from the criteria, waited out plus one minute

add_tests.title: Sign in with a leading and trailing space in the email
steps: Open the sign-in page
Paste '  user@example.com  ' into the email field
Enter the correct password and submit
add_tests.expected: The user is signed in; the stored email is still user@example.com with no spaces.

add_tests.title: Boundary value at 6 attempts (AC-1)
steps: Reach 6 failed sign-in attempts.
Check the result.
add_tests.expected: 6 attempts is past the limit AC-1 states, so it is refused.

add_tests.title: Boundary value at 31 minutes (AC-2)
steps: Wait 31 minutes.
Check the result.
add_tests.expected: 31 minutes is past the 30 minutes it stays locked, so it is no longer locked: it works again.
